state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. The lexer band `E0001`–`E0010`,
the parser band `E0101`–`E0135`, the rejected-PHP band `E0201`–`E0254`, the name-resolution band
`E0301`–`E0327` and the types band from `E0401` through `E0490` carry cards. Every other code is in
the test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201`
prints a code's card.

`Renderer::render_all` closes every run that rendered a coded diagnostic with `AGENT_SHOW_LINE`. Codes
declared and never raised still carry cards, because the test counts declarations: four in the parser
band (`E0103`, `E0104`, `E0106`, `E0107`), two in the rejected-PHP band (`E0206`, `E0207`) and one in
the name-resolution band (`E0302`). Stage 5 is not started.

items.text: **Drain the list, one band slice per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the types band continues at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2067` (`E0491`) through `E0499`, then the codegen codes `E0501`–`E0502` and the configuration band from `E0601` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2165`; about 30 codes a session fits, so this session's slice ends near `E0621` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2368`. A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above each code yourself with one `peek`, and send one `Explore` search for the raise sites, returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code and `NOT RAISED` for a code nothing raises (the checker's builder is `.with_help`, and there are no `.note` calls). Peek the two or three raise sites whose help gives the fix syntax before you copy it: a class test is written `$x is ClassName`, by-reference is `inout` (and `&` in an array literal), a declaration is `var $c = …`, a `foreach` binding is typed (`foreach ($xs as int $v)`), and an options literal is written `{default: false}`. Write every card as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0491");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form), plus one block deleting whole lines of the slice from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4749`, then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow the list. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4779` only in the session that empties `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`: it asserts the list is empty, so landing it earlier turns `bun nv verify` red.
